Notes: Fresh default GET omits Status; Suspended is explicit persisted state. Invalid/empty configuration never erases prior state.

Every call cites native sequence and request ID. Raw preserves actual XML for malformed cases and explicit empty Status; native checksum-mode automatically supplied by botocore is replayed for object reads. Plaintext uses base64.
IAM roles and session policies are real native identities. Trust/policy propagation waits are capture bounds, not emulator delays or AWS latency guarantees.
The native Delegated trust principal is rebound to the harness caller (account root); restricted assumed-role principals and policies otherwise retain their native authorization structure.
Object LastModified binds to native pre-toggle HeadObject; bytes, metadata, ETag and headers remain unchanged across enable/suspend. Reopen flags only reconstruct local durable-state checks.
Correct east and west controls plus actual wrong-regional raw endpoint are observed individually; they do not imply a universal region rule.

Positive request-correlated native GetAccelerateConfiguration/PutAccelerateConfiguration history is retained in archive AuditLookup: only accelerate, bucketName and Host parameters, null responseElements, and no configuration XML. No trail was created and missing delayed records establish no exclusion.
